method: uniform affine based on manual anatomical head measurement; no per-pose bounding-box fitting; native sources retained

stomp.note: Approved pose/timing preserved; root translation externalized for consistent canvas.

qa: This is a key-pose blockout, not smoothly inbetweened production animation.
Cloth, face details and rigid weapon geometry are redrawn by image generation; small contour variation remains.
Anatomical normalization locks head scale and root, while soles and shoulder positions retain measured small source variation.
Reinforcement characters are not spawned or rendered here; the four-monk summon and health thresholds exist only as manifest events.
